response.justification: Bogdan brings over 10 years of full-stack experience across diverse tech stacks, strong architecture skills, and direct exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, Nest.js-like patterns via Node.js, and cloud/container tools — aligning well with the role. His open-source contributions and teaching background signal deep technical curiosity and collaboration aptitude, though his lack of explicit Vitest/Nest.js mention and limited German proficiency are minor concerns.
strengths: 10+ years of proven full-stack experience across frontend, backend, and embedded systems
Direct experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks as required
Strong open-source contributions and demonstrated leadership in testing, CI/CD, and dev practices
concerns: No explicit mention of Vitest or Nest.js in resume (though Node.js/TypeScript experience is strong)
Limited German language proficiency may hinder internal collaboration in Berlin-based team
Resume lacks clear metrics on scalability or performance improvements for enterprise-scale systems
